collection.title: Skoda Favorit 1992 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Favorit 1992 to 2004 requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
